relations.condition: Input is ready, flags.quick is absent, and the route value is groom.
relations.action: Continue to pipeline stage execution with route=groom.
relations.effect: The groom-specific pipeline is selected without treating auto or quick flags as route values.

terminal.outcome: pipeline stage execution continues for the groom route

source_spans.quote:
%% Dispatch runs once is ready. flags.quick takes priority over route. %% Dispatch is entirely on the route field — never on flags.auto/flags.quick, which %% are independent boolean modifiers, not route values (verified: `--auto` alone %% produces route="title_substring", flags={auto:true} — never route="auto"). Start(["input ready"]) --> QuickCheck{"flags.quick present?"} QuickCheck -->|"Yes"| SQ["Load references/workflows/quick/start.md
item_ref = item_ref field, or the quick-mode user_text
(raw text after --quick, unsplit) as the request to derive title/observations from"] SQ --> SQEnd(["STOP — quick workflow handles session"]) QuickCheck -->|"No"| Q1{"route value?"} Q1 -->|"none"| S0["Load references/workflows/work/interactive-browser.md
Step 1.1 — interactive browser"] S0 --> S0End(["STOP — interactive browser handles session"]) Q1 -->|"create"| PipelineCreate(["Continue to pipeline stage execution
(route = create)"]) Q1 -->|"groom"| PipelineGroom(["Continue to pipeline stage execution
(route = groom)"]) Q1 -->|"work"| PipelineWork(["Continue to pipeline stage execution
(route = work)"]) Q1 -->|"issue or title_substring"| PipelineEntry(["Continue to pipeline stage execution
as if route = work — item_ref or user_text
identifies the item; its own
create-if-missing / groom-if-incomplete
chain handles the rest"])

relations.condition: The route is groom and the item reference is either available or absent.
relations.action: When absent, run the create workflow first; when available, run the groom workflow.
relations.effect: Both paths enter the groom start workflow.
